head: f7c40a0d1e28fde596f217b2c297b0734ec67470

scope.question: Does the authentic turn-16 serializer/migration seam alter commander-relevant formation operands for Foča, Gacko, Nevesinje, or Čajniče?

rank_statement.reason: The retained fitness characterization intentionally used null zone and unknown supply and did not execute the week-17 commander candidate pool, eligibility filters, zone assignment, supply narrowing, or sort. It proves an operand change, not an actual rank or selection change.

causal_chain.fact: Frontline duty deliberately adds 0.5 fatigue per turn and stores the resulting number directly in formation.ops.fatigue.

FormationState owns ops as operational degradation state. Canonical serialization strips only five named derived military projections, none of which is formations or ops; the repository's consumer manifest explicitly calls formation.ops.fatigue persisted. The integer-only inline comment conflicts with the live half-point writer and is stale, rather than evidence that fractional fatigue is transient or deprecated.
Both serializeState and serializeRuntimeState call serializePreparedState, which clones through migrateState with schema_version forced to 0.
Forcing version 0 reruns defaultFormations; line 207 maps every non-integer fatigue to 0. The reset was introduced by commit 143ce96556 after the half-point producer introduced by commit 6f3c186824.
Commander force evaluation reads formation.ops.fatigue as a continuous numeric multiplier for offense and defense.
Every successful Advance writes serializeRuntimeState(state) into currentGameStateJson and deserializes that JSON before the next Advance, committing the lossy migration between turns.
The scenario runner assigns runResult.nextState directly to state for the next loop iteration. Its serializeState calls emit artifacts and do not replace the live state.

why: ops.fatigue is persisted formation truth read by combat and commander systems, not one of the five disposable derived military caches.
The live producer intentionally creates valid half-point values, so non-integer does not mean malformed.
The seam loses 10.5 and 2.5 despite Engine Invariants section 11.4 requiring save/load to fully reconstruct formation state.
runtime_bytes_equal_after_roundtrip and canonical_bytes_equal_after_roundtrip only prove idempotence after the first lossy reset; they do not prove fidelity to the raw in-memory state.
persistence_authorities: src/state/game_state.ts:1224-1243 declares ops on persisted FormationState.
src/state/serializeGameState.ts:32-50 enumerates the complete named transient military projection list; formations and ops are not stripped.
docs/10_canon/Systems_Manual_v0_9_0.md:1105 distinguishes the five derived caches from persisted gameplay state.

cohesion_and_morale_defaults.constructor_owner: src/scenario/oob_early_war_entry.ts:331-364 creates cohesion unconditionally but omits morale when OOB initial_morale is absent
cohesion_and_morale_defaults.migration_owner: src/state/save_migration.ts:214-216 adds missing morale as 60 in version-9 defaultFormations

required_source_scope.change: In defaultFormations, preserve every finite fatigue >= 0; default only missing, non-number, non-finite, or negative values to 0. Do not round or rescale.
Correct the stale integer-only FormationOpsState contract to finite non-negative number.
Make validation match the actual half-point producer: finite number >= 0, retaining rejection of NaN, infinities, negative, and non-number values.

explicitly_deferred_from_smallest_fix: No fatigue coefficient, recovery cadence, commander threshold, cohesion, morale, terrain, or operation tuning.

Integer-only reporting guards in scenario_runner.ts and cli/sim_scenario.ts, plus the legacy region/edge front_posture_commitment.ts guard, should receive a separate bounded contract-consistency review because changing them is broader than the proved desktop/headless persistence seam.

focused_production_test_plan: RED then GREEN: a current-schema GameState containing fatigue 10.5 and 2.5 must preserve both exact numbers across deserializeState(serializeState(state)) and deserializeState(serializeRuntimeState(state)).
Exercise the real applyFatigueRecovery producer from an integer starting value to create a half point, then require exact canonical and runtime round-trip preservation.
Keep legacy/malformed behavior: absent ops defaults to fatigue 0; non-number, NaN, infinities, and negative values fail closed to 0 under the migration contract.
Prove integer values remain byte-identical and serializer ordering/hash determinism remains stable across repeated calls.
Pin the Electron source contract that currentGameStateJson uses serializeRuntimeState and the next Advance uses deserializeState, reusing the existing desktop persistence contract test.

preservation_prefix_check_after_reviewed.scope: one authentic 0-to-16 diagnostic prefix using the existing observer; no week 17
pass_conditions: Input digest, clean HEAD/source bindings, turn count, observer count, initial state hash, and ordinary control/report outputs retain their applicable pre-fix values.
Foča 10.5 and Gacko 2.5 survive both runtime and canonical round trips exactly; Nevesinje 4 and Čajniče 8 remain unchanged.
The 25 observed fractional ops.fatigue reset paths disappear and no new formation value/presence difference is introduced.
Repeated runtime and canonical serialization remains byte-identical after round trip.

The turn-16 canonical save hash is expected to move because the old hash encoded lossy zeroes; review the decoded old/new save diff and require it to be limited to the authorized preserved fatigue values plus directly derived hash metadata.
preservation_prefix_check_after_reviewed.stop: Stop on any unrelated gameplay, control, report, or state-path drift. Do not infer week-17 branch repair from a passing prefix.

smallest_next_step: Route this diagnosis through canon/determinism review. If accepted, implement the three-file persistence-contract correction with focused RED/GREEN serializer tests, then run only the bounded 0-to-16 preservation prefix before considering a separately authorized real-runtime week-17 or full native calibration check.
